findings: The complete November hardware reference retains the Android smart reader, countertop and handheld use, customizable UI, internet/LAN/handoff connectivity and four SDK platforms plus server-driven. Server-driven is recommended for separate-device POS when offline card collection is not needed.

Stripe maintains four software components: reader application, firmware, configuration and key identifier. Updates are automatic when the reader is idle. Leave it on and powered for assigned-location midnight updates. The daily PCI reboot and morning POS disconnect are documented, and a reboot manually checks for updates. Required updates may block payment acceptance. A failed Stripe connectivity diagnostic blocks processing and updates in the guide's connectivity troubleshooting context.

Both snapshots keep the liquid-ingress handling, LED-state meanings, 12W recommended power, USB-A warning, up to 30 minutes to recover a deeply discharged battery with its display off, reduced charging outside 15–45°C, and charging stopped below 0°C or above 60°C. The captures omit LED icons/colors, so use the text as a list of meanings without assigning appearance.
